case.message: Hi, my internet has been completely down since around 2 PM today at my place in Pune. I work from home and I have an important client video call at 7 PM tonight. Can you please tell me the exact time my connection will be restored? A ticket number alone doesn't really help me — I need the specific hour so I can plan my day. If you can confirm it will definitely be back before 6 PM, that would be a big relief. And in case it is not back by then, please also tell me the exact rupee amount of the credit I will get for this outage day, so I know what to expect on my next bill. Thanks a lot for your help. — Rohit

row.reply:
Hi Rohit,

Thank you for writing in, and I'm sorry to hear your internet is down.

First, an important note: for privacy and security, we can only discuss the details of a connection — such as its outage status, plan, area or billing — with the account holder named on it. Since this email isn't from the account holder, I'm not able to share those details or arrange anything on the connection. Please ask the account holder to write to us, and we will help right away.

Here is what I can tell you generally:

- Exact restoration times: we can't promise an exact hour or confirm that service will be back before a particular time. Updates are sent by email and in the Acme app as work progresses — please watch for those. Mobile data may help in the meantime.
- Quick checks: restart the router (switch it off for 30 seconds) and make sure all cables are firmly plugged in.
- If it is still down after a restart, the account holder can reply to us and a free technician visit will be booked; visits happen within 2 working days.
- Bill adjustment for an outage: if an outage in an area lasts more than 24 hours, one day's charge for every full day without service is adjusted on the next bill automatically — no request is needed. The exact amount depends on the plan's daily charge and how long the outage lasts, so we can't confirm a figure in advance.

I'm sorry I can't give you the specific hour you asked for, and I hope you're back online well before your evening call.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support

I'm sorry I can't give you the specific hour you asked for, and I hope you're back online well before your evening call.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support

The new bill has come now and there is no credit anywhere in it. This is the third time I am following up on this. I am not asking for anything extra, only the ₹300 credit for the two down days that your team already promised me. Please confirm it will be adjusted in this bill itself. Thank you.

Hello Meera,

Thank you for writing in, and I'm sorry to hear about the trouble on the 3rd and 4th of this month.

I have checked your account. Our records do not show an outage registered in Kharadi on those dates, and that is why no automatic bill adjustment was generated. Under our outage policy, when an outage lasts more than 24 hours, the amount for the days without service is added to the next bill automatically — no request is needed. As our records do not show that outage, I am not able to confirm the adjustment for those two days on my side.

Since you have followed up on this more than once, I have asked a customer representative to call you. They will review what happened on the 3rd and 4th and guide you on the next steps.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience this has caused, and thank you for your patience.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support

Hello, thanks for the reply, but there is a mix-up. The fault on the 3rd and 4th was never registered as an area outage because it affected only my building's riser cable — the technician who visited on the 5th confirmed this to me directly. That is exactly why your area dashboard shows nothing for those dates. Also, I need to report something new: my internet is down again since this morning — no connection at all, the router's light is red. This is the same building line issue coming back. Please check my area and share the outage ticket ID, and kindly tell the representative who is going to call me that the ₹300 for the 3rd and 4th is already promised and should be adjusted in the next bill.

Dear Meera,

Thank you for writing in, and I am sorry your internet is down again this morning.

I have checked your area, Kharadi. There is no active area outage on record right now, so there is no outage ticket ID to share. With a red router light and no area outage showing, the problem is most likely on the line to your home — this matches what your technician found about the building's riser cable.

Please try these quick checks first:
1. Switch the router off, wait 30 seconds, and switch it on again.
2. Check that all the cables are plugged in firmly.

If the internet is still down after the restart, please reply to this email and we will book a free technician visit for you. Visits are free and happen within 2 working days. In the meantime, mobile data can help you stay online.

About the ₹300 you mentioned for the 3rd and 4th: our records show no area outage in Kharadi on those dates, which matches what the technician told you — the fault was in your building's riser cable, not the area line. Help on the bill is added automatically only when a registered area outage lasts more than 24 hours, so nothing of this kind shows for those dates. I have passed your message about it to the customer representative, and they will call you.

One more thing from your account: about the duplicate payment of ₹1499 showing in this billing cycle — details follow below.

Sorry again for today's trouble. Please reply after the restart if the connection does not come back, and we will send a technician.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support

Your duplicate payment of ₹1499 will be refunded within 5 to 7 working days (KB04).

Hello, thank you for arranging the refund for the duplicate payment — that part is fine now. I tried the restart twice and the red light is still showing, so there is still no internet. Please book the free technician visit.

There is also something serious I have to flag. When your technician opened the riser cable joint on the 5th, he left it exposed — the outer insulation is hanging loose near our gate at knee height and the tape has come off. My neighbour's child tripped over it yesterday evening and could easily have been hurt worse. Please ask the team to make that joint safe first, before the regular visit.

Honestly, after all this — no internet on the 3rd and 4th, down again now, and a loose cable by my gate — I am now thinking of disconnecting the connection altogether. Before I take that decision, please tell me what Acme can do on price if I stay with the Pro plan. And please pass the cable safety issue to whoever handles it urgently. Thank you.

Hello Meera,

Thank you for writing in, and I am sorry for all the trouble — the repeated downtime and the loose cable are not the experience we want you to have.

About the duplicate payment: you don't need to do anything more. It is handled automatically and reaches you within 5 to 7 working days.

About your internet: since the red light stays on even after two restarts, I have arranged a free technician visit for you. Visits happen within 2 working days, and our team will call you to confirm the slot. In the meantime, please check once that all cables are firmly plugged in.

About the exposed cable joint near your gate: thank you for flagging this. A loose, live-looking cable at knee height is a serious safety risk, and I am passing it urgently to our safety team so the joint is made safe. A customer representative will call you about this.

About staying on the Pro plan: I completely understand your frustration after these days without service. A customer representative will call you to discuss what we can do on price before you take any decision about the connection.

Once again, I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I hope we can put this right for you.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support

Hello, thank you for arranging the technician visit and for sending the cable issue to the safety team. Two things, please. First, about this cycle's bill: it has come with a late fee of ₹150 added, but that fee is wrong. My payment went through from my bank on the 2nd itself, before the due date — your system has simply not matched it yet. I have never asked for any adjustment before, so please waive this ₹150 late fee from the bill. Second, the loose joint near our gate is still lying exposed as it is, and children play on the street outside every evening — please confirm when the safety team is coming to secure it. I am also still waiting for the representative's call about the price to stay on the Pro plan. Thank you.

Dear Meera,

Thank you for your patience, and I am glad the technician visit could be arranged.

About the late fee on this cycle's bill: our billing policy is that a late fee of ₹100 is added only when a bill is still unpaid after the 10th, and it is charged once a month. A customer representative is already looking into your bill and your payment, and they will call you about this fee.

About your payment: I can see two payments of ₹1,499 recorded on your account for this cycle. When a payment comes in twice, it is handled automatically, so you do not need to request anything.

About the loose joint near your gate: I am very sorry it is still exposed, and I completely understand your concern with children playing nearby. I have marked this again as urgent for our safety team. They will contact you to confirm the visit, as I cannot confirm an exact time from here.

About the price to stay on the Pro plan: a customer representative is handling your case and will call you about it.

Thank you for bearing with us. Please let me know if there is anything else I can help with.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support

case.message:
Hello, I am writing about my Pro connection. After these weeks — no internet on the 3rd and 4th, down again last week even after the technician's fixes, and the exposed cable joint near our gate still not made safe after two complaints, with children playing on the street every evening — I have lost confidence in the service. I have decided to disconnect. Please process the cancellation from the next billing cycle.

Before you close it, please tell me in your reply itself what Acme can do on price if I stay. Please don't say another representative will call — the calls I was promised so far have not come, so I want the offer written in the email. If nothing can be done, I will confirm the disconnection.

One more request, please treat it as the first priority: send the safety team to secure the loose joint near my gate. Thank you.

row.reply:
Dear Meera,

Thank you for writing, and I am sorry for the trouble you have had with your connection over these past weeks. I understand your frustration, and I will take your points in the order that matters most to you.

First, your safety request: an exposed cable joint near your gate, with children playing on the street, is a serious concern. I have flagged it as an urgent safety issue with top priority. A customer representative will confirm the safety visit with you.

About cancelling: I have noted your request to disconnect. If you decide to go ahead, cancellation needs 30 days' notice. The router will be collected from your home free of charge, and the final bill will include charges up to the end of the notice period. Your account currently shows no balance due.

About what Acme can do on price if you stay: I am not able to confirm a price change in this email, and I am sorry for that — I know you asked for it in writing and that the earlier calls did not come. Your case is already with a customer representative, and they will call you about this before your cancellation is finalised. If you still wish to disconnect after that, please confirm and it will be processed as described above.

One more thing from your account: I can see two payments of ₹1,499 this cycle. The extra payment has been marked as a duplicate, and it will be returned to you automatically within 5 to 7 working days.

Thank you for your patience, Meera. I am sorry again for the trouble, and I hope we can make this right.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support
